title: The Moon Climbs Nancy's Mountain
skyStory: The moon has crossed into Capricorn, Nancy's own sign, a quarter lit and puffing slightly from the climb. It has brought a thermos and a very serious hiking map. Saturn, who rules this mountain, rolls out a welcome mat it knitted itself. Mars watches from a lower ledge, impressed and pretending not to be. Frost glitters on the windshields at dawn like the sky dusted for company.

reading: With the moon visiting Nancy's sign, your job today is to be the good neighbour at the foot of the mountain. Keep the chimney going. Wave when you see a light up top.

Around 1:45 pm you will catch yourself rushing something that does not need to be rushed. Capricorn energy moves like a mountain goat: slow, sure, and somehow always at the summit first. Try it. Walk at half speed from your desk to the kettle and notice three things you usually miss. One of them will be funny. Tell Nancy about it, because today she is technically the landlord of the sky.
joel.mission: Move the onyx to your giving wrist before your first coffee and leave it there until the streetlights blink on, sending steady strength up the mountain.
joel.omen: Frost shaped like a little peak on a car roof. Nancy's mountain is saying thanks for the strength.
joel.stoneWhy: matching her pinky for the day

reading: The moon is in your house today and it has put its feet up on your coffee table. You are allowed to be the host who also relaxes. Saturn, your ruler, says even mountains take a seat sometimes.

Expect to be quietly correct about something at least twice before supper. The Wood Rat spots the flaw in a plan, the typo in a sign, the reason the printer is sulking. You may choose to fix one and simply smile at the other. Tonight, before bed, stand by a window for one breath and look up. The quarter moon is in your sign and it would love a wave from the owner.
nancy.mission: Give one person a compliment so specific it makes them squint, like praising the exact angle of their scarf.
nancy.omen: Hoofprints in the frost, or a lone figure climbing a steep hill. Your patience is about to reach a summit.

together.text: Since the moon is staying on Nancy's mountain, Joel sends one photo of something steady and Nancy replies with one photo of something sparkly. Together they make a postcard from the summit. Keep it as the moon's guestbook entry.
